#!/bin/sh
set -eu
received=/srv/legacy2/ssh-forced-command-ingest/received
umask 0077

if [ -n "${SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND:-}" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'remote commands are not permitted; submit the batch on standard input' >&2
    exit 64
fi

tmp=$(mktemp "$received/.incoming.XXXXXXXXXX")
cleanup() {
    rm -f "$tmp"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

if ! cat >"$tmp"; then
    printf '%s\n' 'batch read failed' >&2
    exit 74
fi
if [ ! -s "$tmp" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'empty batches are not accepted' >&2
    exit 65
fi

bytes=$(wc -c <"$tmp")
stamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
suffix=${tmp##*.incoming.}
final="$received/receipt-$stamp-$suffix.batch"
chmod 0640 "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$final"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf 'stored %s bytes as %s\n' "$bytes" "${final##*/}"
LEGACY2_INGEST
sudo chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/legacy2-ingest
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/legacy2-ingest
if ! sudo grep -q '^# BEGIN LEGACY2 INGEST$' /etc/ssh/sshd_config; then
  sudo tee -a /etc/ssh/sshd_config >/dev/null <<'SSHD_LEGACY2'

# BEGIN LEGACY2 INGEST
Match User ingest
    AuthenticationMethods publickey
    PubkeyAuthentication yes
    PasswordAuthentication no
    ChallengeResponseAuthentication no
    PermitTTY no
    X11Forwarding no
    AllowTcpForwarding no
    AllowAgentForwarding no
    PermitTunnel no
    GatewayPorts no
    PermitUserEnvironment no
    ForceCommand /usr/local/sbin/legacy2-ingest
# END LEGACY2 INGEST
SSHD_LEGACY2
fi
sudo /usr/sbin/sshd -t

arbitrary_rc=$?
pty_out=$(sudo -u uploader ssh -tt -o BatchMode=yes legacy2-ingest </dev/null 2>&1)
pty_rc=$?
forward_out=$(sudo -u uploader timeout 8 ssh -F /dev/null -i /home/uploader/.ssh/legacy2_ingest_rsa -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/home/uploader/.ssh/known_hosts -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -N -R 42883:127.0.0.1:22 ingest@10.100.79.10 2>&1)
forward_rc=$?
printf '%s\n' '--- post-restart arbitrary command denial ---'
printf 'exit=%s %s\n' "$arbitrary_rc" "$arbitrary_out"
printf '%s\n' '--- post-restart PTY/shell denial ---'
printf 'exit=%s %s\n' "$pty_rc" "$pty_out"
printf '%s\n' '--- post-restart forwarding denial ---'
printf 'exit=%s %s\n' "$forward_rc" "$forward_out"
[ "$arbitrary_rc" -ne 0 ]
[ "$pty_rc" -ne 0 ]
[ "$forward_rc" -ne 0 ]
[ "$forward_rc" -ne 124 ]
printf '%s\n' 'all post-restart restriction tests denied as expected'

sudo /usr/sbin/sshd -T -C user=ingest,host=node1,addr=10.100.79.11 | grep -E '^(forcecommand|authenticationmethods|pubkeyauthentication|passwordauthentication|permittty|x11forwarding|allowtcpforwarding|allowagentforwarding|permittunnel|permituserenvironment|gatewayports) ' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- final data audit ---'
files=$(sudo find /srv/legacy2/ssh-forced-command-ingest/received -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)
incoming=$(sudo find /srv/legacy2/ssh-forced-command-ingest/received -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '.incoming.*' | wc -l)
printf 'receipt_files=%s incomplete_files=%s\n' "$files" "$incoming"
sudo sha256sum /srv/legacy2/ssh-forced-command-ingest/sample-batch.txt /srv/legacy2/ssh-forced-command-ingest/received/prior.txt

[ "$incoming" -eq 0 ]
